questionnaire.name: SmartUrbanity - Your Experience on the Move

welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Experience on the Move
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire asks about how you feel and what you experience while travelling, including walking, cycling, public transport, car, motorcycle and route quality. Your answers help identify barriers and opportunities for better urban mobility. Participation is voluntary and anonymous.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questionnaire.title: 4. Your Experience On the Move

sections.title: Emotional experience
sections.description: The following questions refer to your typical journey (the trip you most commonly make in your daily life, such as travelling to work, university, school, shopping, or other regular activities).

questions.text: How would you describe your emotional state during a typical journey?
Thinking about your typical journey, how does the time it actually takes compare to how long you expect it to take?
How would you describe your level of tiredness or fatigue after completing your typical journey?
If your typical journey makes you feel tired, what do you think is the main cause?

options.text: Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling, carrying bags)
Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation, time pressure, feeling unsafe or insecure)
Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, noise, poor air quality)
Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in queues)
I usually do not feel tired after my trips

questions.text: How often do you feel anxious or overwhelmed during your typical journey?
What specifically makes you feel anxious or overwhelmed during your typical journey?

options.text: Aggressive or unsafe behavior from other road users (drivers, cyclists, pedestrians)
Noise, crowding, or other sensory overload
Time pressure or risk of being late
Feeling isolated or alone while traveling
Safety and security concerns (e.g., accidents, crime)
I don't usually feel anxious or overwhelmed

questions.text: Compared to other travel options available to you (e.g., walking, driving, public transport), how would you rate the overall effort required by your usual mode of travel?

options.text: My current mode is significantly easier and more relaxing than any alternative
This is a bit easier than other ways I could travel
Regardless of the mode the effort feels roughly equal
This takes a bit more out of me than other options would
Far more demanding than alternatives (physically or mentally)

questions.text: How does the level of 'liveliness' (the presence of other people, shops, and activity) on your route affect your journey?

options.text: Very positively, lively environments make me feel safer or more comfortable
Somewhat positively, lively environments improve my travel experience
Neutral, the level of activity does not affect my journey
Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty areas can make me feel uncomfortable
Very negatively, overly busy or crowded areas make the journey stressful or difficult to navigate

it.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience on the: SmartUrbanity - La tua esperienza durante gli spostamenti
it.#4. Your Experience On the Move: 4. La tua esperienza durante gli spostamenti
it.#Welcome to Your Experience on the Move: Benvenuto/a nel questionario sulla tua esperienza durante gli spostamenti
it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity riguarda le tue sensazioni e le tue esperienze durante gli spostamenti, inclusi gli spostamenti a piedi, in bicicletta, con il trasporto pubblico, in auto e in moto, nonché la qualità dei percorsi. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a individuare ostacoli e opportunità per migliorare la mobilità urbana. La partecipazione è volontaria e anonima.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>The following questions refer to you: Le seguenti domande si riferiscono al tuo spostamento abituale, cioè quello che effettui più frequentemente nella vita quotidiana, ad esempio per andare al lavoro, all'università, a scuola, a fare acquisti o per altre attività regolari.
it.#How would you describe your emotional s: Come descriveresti il tuo stato emotivo durante uno spostamento abituale?
it.#Thinking about your typical journey, ho: Pensando al tuo spostamento abituale, come si confronta il tempo effettivamente impiegato con quello che ti aspetti di impiegare?
it.#How would you describe your level of ti: Come descriveresti il tuo livello di stanchezza o affaticamento dopo aver completato il tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Se il tuo spostamento abituale ti fa sentire stanco/a, quale pensi sia la causa principale?
it.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Sforzo fisico (ad es. camminare, andare in bicicletta, trasportare borse)
it.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Stress mentale (ad es. traffico, orientamento, pressione del tempo, sensazione di insicurezza o pericolo)
it.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Disagio ambientale (ad es. caldo, rumore, scarsa qualità dell'aria)
it.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Attesa e permanenza in piedi (ad es. alle fermate o in coda)
it.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: Di solito non mi sento stanco/a dopo i miei spostamenti
it.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: Con quale frequenza ti senti ansioso/a o sopraffatto/a durante il tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#What specifically makes you feel anxiou: Cosa ti fa sentire in particolare ansioso/a o sopraffatto/a durante il tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#Aggressive or unsafe behavior from othe: Comportamenti aggressivi o pericolosi da parte di altri utenti della strada (automobilisti, ciclisti, pedoni)
it.#Noise, crowding, or other sensory overl: Rumore, affollamento o altri sovraccarichi sensoriali
it.#Time pressure or risk of being late: Pressione del tempo o rischio di arrivare in ritardo
it.#Feeling isolated or alone while traveli: Sentirsi isolato/a o solo/a durante lo spostamento
it.#Safety and security concerns (e.g., acc: Preoccupazioni relative alla sicurezza personale e stradale (ad es. incidenti, criminalità)
it.#Physical health concerns (pain, breathl: Problemi legati alla salute fisica (dolore, affanno, vertigini)
it.#I don't usually feel anxious or overwhe: Di solito non mi sento ansioso/a o sopraffatto/a
it.#Compared to other travel options availa: Rispetto alle altre modalità di trasporto a tua disposizione (ad es. a piedi, in auto, con il trasporto pubblico), come valuteresti lo sforzo complessivo richiesto dalla modalità che utilizzi abitualmente?
it.#My current mode is significantly easier: La modalità che utilizzo attualmente è decisamente più facile e rilassante di qualsiasi alternativa
it.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: È un po' più facile rispetto alle altre modalità con cui potrei spostarmi
it.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Indipendentemente dalla modalità, lo sforzo mi sembra più o meno equivalente
it.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Questa modalità richiede un po' più di energie rispetto alle altre opzioni
it.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Molto più impegnativa delle alternative, dal punto di vista fisico o mentale
it.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: In che modo il livello di «vivacità» del percorso, cioè la presenza di altre persone, negozi e attività, influisce sul tuo spostamento?
it.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Molto positivamente: gli ambienti vivaci mi fanno sentire più sicuro/a o a mio agio
it.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Abbastanza positivamente: gli ambienti vivaci migliorano la mia esperienza di viaggio
it.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: In modo neutro: il livello di attività non influisce sul mio spostamento
it.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Abbastanza negativamente: le zone tranquille o deserte possono farmi sentire a disagio
it.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Molto negativamente: le zone eccessivamente trafficate o affollate rendono lo spostamento stressante o difficile da affrontare

fr.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience on the: SmartUrbanity - Votre expérience pendant vos déplacements
fr.#Welcome to Your Experience on the Move: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur votre expérience pendant vos déplacements
fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur vos sensations et votre expérience pendant vos déplacements, notamment à pied, à vélo, en transports publics, en voiture ou à moto, ainsi que sur la qualité des itinéraires. Vos réponses nous aident à repérer les obstacles et les possibilités d’amélioration de la mobilité urbaine. La participation est volontaire et anonyme.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>The following questions refer to you: Les questions suivantes concernent votre trajet habituel, c’est-à-dire celui que vous faites le plus souvent dans votre vie quotidienne, par exemple pour aller au travail, à l’université, à l’école, faire des courses ou participer à d’autres activités régulières.
fr.#How would you describe your emotional s: Comment décririez-vous votre état émotionnel pendant un trajet habituel ?
fr.#Thinking about your typical journey, ho: Pour votre trajet habituel, comment le temps réellement nécessaire se compare-t-il au temps que vous pensiez mettre ?
fr.#Slightly shorter than expected: Un peu plus court que prévu
fr.#Slightly longer than expected: Un peu plus long que prévu
fr.#How would you describe your level of ti: Comment décririez-vous votre niveau de fatigue après votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Si votre trajet habituel vous fatigue, quelle en est selon vous la principale cause ?
fr.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Effort physique (par ex. marcher, faire du vélo, porter des sacs)
fr.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Stress mental (par ex. trafic, orientation, manque de temps, sentiment d’insécurité)
fr.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Inconfort lié à l’environnement (par ex. chaleur, bruit, mauvaise qualité de l’air)
fr.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Attente et station debout (par ex. aux arrêts ou dans les files d’attente)
fr.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: En général, je ne suis pas fatigué(e) après mes déplacements
fr.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: À quelle fréquence vous sentez-vous anxieux(se) ou dépassé(e) pendant votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#What specifically makes you feel anxiou: Qu’est-ce qui vous rend particulièrement anxieux(se) ou dépassé(e) pendant votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#Aggressive or unsafe behavior from othe: Comportement agressif ou dangereux d’autres usagers de la route (conducteurs, cyclistes, piétons)
fr.#Noise, crowding, or other sensory overl: Bruit, foule ou trop nombreuses stimulations autour de moi
fr.#Time pressure or risk of being late: Manque de temps ou risque d’arriver en retard
fr.#Feeling isolated or alone while traveli: Sentiment d’être isolé(e) ou seul(e) pendant le déplacement
fr.#Safety and security concerns (e.g., acc: Préoccupations liées à la sécurité routière ou personnelle (par ex. accidents, criminalité)
fr.#Physical health concerns (pain, breathl: Problèmes de santé physique (douleur, essoufflement, vertiges)
fr.#I don't usually feel anxious or overwhe: En général, je ne me sens pas anxieux(se) ou dépassé(e)
fr.#Compared to other travel options availa: Par rapport aux autres possibilités de déplacement dont vous disposez, par exemple la marche, la voiture ou les transports publics, comment évaluez-vous l’effort global demandé par votre mode de transport habituel ?
fr.#My current mode is significantly easier: Mon mode actuel est nettement plus facile et plus reposant que toutes les autres possibilités
fr.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: C’est un peu plus facile que les autres façons dont je pourrais me déplacer
fr.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Quel que soit le mode, l’effort me semble à peu près le même
fr.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Ce mode me demande un peu plus d’effort que les autres possibilités
fr.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Beaucoup plus exigeant que les autres possibilités, physiquement ou mentalement
fr.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: Comment le niveau d’animation de votre itinéraire, c’est-à-dire la présence d’autres personnes, de commerces et d’activités, influence-t-il votre trajet ?
fr.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Très positivement : les endroits animés me font sentir plus en sécurité ou plus à l’aise
fr.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Plutôt positivement : les endroits animés améliorent mon expérience de déplacement
fr.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: De façon neutre : le niveau d’activité n’influence pas mon trajet
fr.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Plutôt négativement : les endroits calmes ou vides peuvent me mettre mal à l’aise
fr.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Très négativement : les endroits trop fréquentés ou bondés rendent le trajet stressant ou difficile

de.#Welcome to Your Experience on the Move: Willkommen beim Fragebogen zu Ihrer Erfahrung unterwegs
de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich damit, wie Sie sich während Ihrer Wege fühlen und was Sie dabei erleben, zum Beispiel zu Fuß, mit dem Fahrrad, mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, mit dem Auto oder Motorrad sowie in Bezug auf die Qualität der Wege. Ihre Antworten helfen uns, Hindernisse und Möglichkeiten für eine bessere städtische Mobilität zu erkennen. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und anonym.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#<p>The following questions refer to you: Die folgenden Fragen beziehen sich auf Ihren typischen Weg, also den Weg, den Sie im Alltag am häufigsten machen, zum Beispiel zur Arbeit, Universität, Schule, zum Einkaufen oder zu anderen regelmäßigen Aktivitäten.
de.#How would you describe your emotional s: Wie würden Sie Ihren Gefühlszustand während eines typischen Weges beschreiben?
de.#Thinking about your typical journey, ho: Wenn Sie an Ihren typischen Weg denken: Wie unterscheidet sich die tatsächliche Dauer von der Zeit, die Sie erwarten?
de.#How would you describe your level of ti: Wie würden Sie Ihre Müdigkeit nach Ihrem typischen Weg beschreiben?
de.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Wenn Ihr typischer Weg Sie müde macht: Was ist Ihrer Meinung nach der Hauptgrund?
de.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Körperliche Anstrengung (z. B. Gehen, Radfahren, Taschen tragen)
de.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Psychischer Stress (z. B. Verkehr, Orientierung, Zeitdruck, Gefühl von Unsicherheit)
de.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Unangenehme Umweltbedingungen (z. B. Hitze, Lärm, schlechte Luftqualität)
de.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Warten und Stehen (z. B. an Haltestellen oder in Warteschlangen)
de.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: Normalerweise bin ich nach meinen Wegen nicht müde
de.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: Wie oft fühlen Sie sich während Ihres typischen Weges ängstlich oder überfordert?
de.#What specifically makes you feel anxiou: Was genau führt dazu, dass Sie sich während Ihres typischen Weges ängstlich oder überfordert fühlen?
de.#Aggressive or unsafe behavior from othe: Aggressives oder gefährliches Verhalten anderer Verkehrsteilnehmender (Autofahrer, Radfahrer, Fußgänger)
de.#Noise, crowding, or other sensory overl: Lärm, Gedränge oder zu viele Reize
de.#Time pressure or risk of being late: Zeitdruck oder die Gefahr, zu spät zu kommen
de.#Feeling isolated or alone while traveli: Das Gefühl, während des Weges isoliert oder allein zu sein
de.#Safety and security concerns (e.g., acc: Bedenken wegen Verkehrssicherheit oder persönlicher Sicherheit (z. B. Unfälle, Kriminalität)
de.#I don't usually feel anxious or overwhe: Normalerweise fühle ich mich nicht ängstlich oder überfordert
de.#Compared to other travel options availa: Verglichen mit anderen Möglichkeiten, die Ihnen zur Verfügung stehen, zum Beispiel Gehen, Autofahren oder öffentlicher Verkehr: Wie hoch ist der gesamte Aufwand bei Ihrem üblichen Verkehrsmittel?
de.#My current mode is significantly easier: Mein derzeitiges Verkehrsmittel ist deutlich einfacher und entspannter als alle Alternativen
de.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Es ist etwas einfacher als andere Möglichkeiten, die ich nutzen könnte
de.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Unabhängig vom Verkehrsmittel fühlt sich der Aufwand ungefähr gleich an
de.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Dieses Verkehrsmittel kostet mich etwas mehr Kraft als andere Möglichkeiten
de.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Deutlich anstrengender als die Alternativen, körperlich oder mental
de.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: Wie beeinflusst die Belebtheit Ihrer Strecke, also die Anwesenheit anderer Menschen, Geschäfte und Aktivitäten, Ihren Weg?
de.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Sehr positiv: Belebte Orte geben mir mehr Sicherheit oder Komfort
de.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Eher positiv: Belebte Orte verbessern mein Erlebnis unterwegs
de.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: Neutral: Die Belebtheit beeinflusst meinen Weg nicht
de.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Eher negativ: Ruhige oder leere Bereiche können dazu führen, dass ich mich unwohl fühle
de.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Sehr negativ: Sehr belebte oder überfüllte Bereiche machen den Weg stressig oder schwer überschaubar

tr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Bu SmartUrbanity anketi yürürken, bisiklete binerken, toplu taşıma kullanırken, otomobille veya motosikletle seyahat ederken neler yaşadığınız ve nasıl hissettiğinizle ilgilidir. Güzergâh kalitesi de bu deneyimin bir parçasıdır. Yanıtlarınız, daha iyi kentsel hareketlilik için engelleri ve iyileştirme fırsatlarını belirlememize yardımcı olur. Katılım gönüllü ve anonimdir.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#<p>The following questions refer to you: Aşağıdaki sorular tipik yolculuğunuzla ilgilidir. Bu, günlük yaşamda en sık yaptığınız yolculuktur; örneğin işe, üniversiteye, okula, alışverişe veya düzenli başka bir etkinliğe giderken yaptığınız yolculuk.
tr.#How would you describe your emotional s: Tipik bir yolculuk sırasında duygusal durumunuzu nasıl tanımlarsınız?
tr.#Thinking about your typical journey, ho: Tipik yolculuğunuzu düşündüğünüzde, gerçekten geçen süre beklediğiniz süreyle nasıl karşılaştırılır?
tr.#How would you describe your level of ti: Tipik yolculuğunuzu tamamladıktan sonra ne kadar yorgun hissedersiniz?
tr.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Tipik yolculuğunuz sizi yoruyorsa sizce bunun temel nedeni nedir?
tr.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Fiziksel çaba (ör. yürümek, bisiklete binmek, çanta taşımak)
tr.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Zihinsel stres (ör. trafik, yön bulma, zaman baskısı, kendini güvensiz hissetme)
tr.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Çevresel rahatsızlık (ör. sıcak, gürültü, kötü hava kalitesi)
tr.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Bekleme ve ayakta durma (ör. duraklarda veya kuyruklarda)
tr.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: Tipik yolculuğunuz sırasında ne sıklıkta kaygılı veya bunalmış hissedersiniz?
tr.#What specifically makes you feel anxiou: Tipik yolculuğunuz sırasında sizi özellikle kaygılı veya bunalmış hissettiren nedir?
tr.#Aggressive or unsafe behavior from othe: Diğer yol kullanıcılarının saldırgan veya tehlikeli davranışları (sürücüler, bisikletliler, yayalar)
tr.#Time pressure or risk of being late: Zaman baskısı veya geç kalma riski
tr.#Feeling isolated or alone while traveli: Yolculuk sırasında kendimi yalnız veya izole hissetmek
tr.#Safety and security concerns (e.g., acc: Trafik güvenliği veya kişisel güvenlikle ilgili kaygılar (ör. kazalar, suç)
tr.#Physical health concerns (pain, breathl: Fiziksel sağlık sorunları (ağrı, nefes darlığı, baş dönmesi)
tr.#Compared to other travel options availa: Yürüme, otomobil veya toplu taşıma gibi kullanabileceğiniz diğer seçeneklerle karşılaştırıldığında, genellikle kullandığınız ulaşım seçeneğinin gerektirdiği toplam çabayı nasıl değerlendirirsiniz?
tr.#My current mode is significantly easier: Şu an kullandığım seçenek diğer tüm alternatiflerden belirgin şekilde daha kolay ve rahat
tr.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Kullanabileceğim diğer seçeneklerden biraz daha kolay
tr.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Hangi ulaşım seçeneğini kullansam da gereken çaba yaklaşık aynı
tr.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Bu seçenek diğerlerine göre biraz daha fazla enerji harcamamı gerektiriyor
tr.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Alternatiflere göre fiziksel veya zihinsel olarak çok daha yorucu
tr.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: Güzergâhınızdaki canlılık düzeyi, yani başka insanların, dükkânların ve etkinliklerin varlığı, yolculuğunuzu nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Çok olumlu: canlı yerler kendimi daha güvende veya rahat hissettirir
tr.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Biraz olumlu: canlı yerler yolculuk deneyimimi iyileştirir
tr.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Biraz olumsuz: sessiz veya boş alanlar beni rahatsız edebilir

fa.#Welcome to Your Experience on the Move: به پرسشنامه تجربه رفت‌وآمد خوش آمدید
fa.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
این پرسشنامه SmartUrbanity درباره احساس و تجربه شما هنگام رفت‌وآمد است؛ از جمله پیاده‌روی، دوچرخه‌سواری، حمل‌ونقل عمومی، خودرو، موتورسیکلت و کیفیت مسیر. پاسخ‌های شما به ما کمک می‌کند موانع و فرصت‌های بهبود جابه‌جایی شهری را شناسایی کنیم. شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه و ناشناس است.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>The following questions refer to you: سؤال‌های زیر درباره سفر معمول شماست؛ یعنی سفری که در زندگی روزمره بیشتر انجام می‌دهید، مثلاً رفتن به محل کار، دانشگاه، مدرسه، خرید یا فعالیت‌های منظم دیگر.
fa.#How would you describe your emotional s: حالت روحی خود را در طول یک سفر معمول چگونه توصیف می‌کنید؟
fa.#Thinking about your typical journey, ho: وقتی به سفر معمول خود فکر می‌کنید، زمان واقعی سفر نسبت به زمانی که انتظار دارید چگونه است؟
fa.#How would you describe your level of ti: پس از پایان سفر معمول خود، میزان خستگی‌تان را چگونه توصیف می‌کنید؟
fa.#If your typical journey makes you feel: اگر سفر معمول شما باعث خستگی می‌شود، فکر می‌کنید دلیل اصلی چیست؟
fa.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: تلاش جسمی (مثلاً پیاده‌روی، دوچرخه‌سواری، حمل کیف)
fa.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: فشار ذهنی (مثلاً ترافیک، مسیریابی، کمبود وقت، احساس ناامنی)
fa.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: ناراحتی محیطی (مثلاً گرما، صدا، کیفیت پایین هوا)
fa.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: انتظار و ایستادن (مثلاً در ایستگاه یا صف)
fa.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: معمولاً بعد از سفرهایم خسته نمی‌شوم
fa.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: در طول سفر معمول خود چند وقت یک بار احساس اضطراب یا درماندگی می‌کنید؟
fa.#What specifically makes you feel anxiou: چه چیزهایی در سفر معمول شما باعث می‌شود احساس اضطراب یا درماندگی کنید؟
fa.#Aggressive or unsafe behavior from othe: رفتار تهاجمی یا خطرناک سایر کاربران راه (رانندگان، دوچرخه‌سواران، عابران)
fa.#Noise, crowding, or other sensory overl: سر و صدا، شلوغی یا تحریک حسی زیاد
fa.#Time pressure or risk of being late: کمبود وقت یا خطر دیر رسیدن
fa.#Feeling isolated or alone while traveli: احساس تنهایی یا انزوا هنگام سفر
fa.#Safety and security concerns (e.g., acc: نگرانی درباره ایمنی ترافیکی یا امنیت شخصی (مثلاً تصادف، جرم)
fa.#I don't usually feel anxious or overwhe: معمولاً احساس اضطراب یا درماندگی نمی‌کنم
fa.#Compared to other travel options availa: در مقایسه با گزینه‌های دیگر مانند پیاده‌روی، رانندگی یا حمل‌ونقل عمومی، میزان تلاش کلی موردنیاز برای روش معمول رفت‌وآمد خود را چگونه ارزیابی می‌کنید؟
fa.#My current mode is significantly easier: روش فعلی من به‌طور محسوسی آسان‌تر و آرام‌تر از همه گزینه‌های دیگر است
fa.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: کمی آسان‌تر از روش‌های دیگری است که می‌توانم استفاده کنم
fa.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: صرف‌نظر از روش، میزان تلاش تقریباً یکسان است
fa.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: این روش کمی بیشتر از گزینه‌های دیگر از من انرژی می‌گیرد
fa.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: از نظر جسمی یا ذهنی بسیار سخت‌تر از گزینه‌های دیگر است
fa.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: میزان «زندگی و فعالیت» در مسیر شما، یعنی حضور افراد، فروشگاه‌ها و فعالیت‌ها، چگونه بر سفرتان اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Very positively, lively environments ma: بسیار مثبت؛ محیط‌های پررفت‌وآمد باعث می‌شوند احساس امنیت یا راحتی بیشتری کنم
fa.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: تا حدی مثبت؛ محیط‌های پررفت‌وآمد تجربه سفر مرا بهتر می‌کنند
fa.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: خنثی؛ میزان فعالیت اطراف بر سفرم اثری ندارد
fa.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: تا حدی منفی؛ مناطق آرام یا خالی ممکن است باعث ناراحتی من شوند
fa.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: بسیار منفی؛ مناطق بسیار شلوغ یا پرازدحام سفر را پراسترس یا جهت‌یابی را دشوار می‌کنند

hu.#Welcome to Your Experience on the Move: Üdvözöljük az utazási tapasztalatokról szóló kérdőívben
hu.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Ez a SmartUrbanity kérdőív arról szól, hogyan érzi magát és mit tapasztal utazás közben, például gyalog, kerékpárral, tömegközlekedéssel, autóval vagy motorkerékpárral, valamint milyen az útvonal minősége. Válaszai segítenek feltárni a városi közlekedés akadályait és fejlesztési lehetőségeit. A részvétel önkéntes és anonim.

További információ a SmartUrbanity projektről
hu.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Válaszát rögzítettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt a kérdőív kitöltésére.
hu.#<p>The following questions refer to you: A következő kérdések az Ön tipikus utazására vonatkoznak, vagyis arra az útra, amelyet a mindennapi életben a leggyakrabban tesz meg, például munkába, egyetemre, iskolába, vásárolni vagy más rendszeres tevékenységhez.
hu.#How would you describe your emotional s: Hogyan jellemezné az érzelmi állapotát egy tipikus utazás során?
hu.#Thinking about your typical journey, ho: Ha a tipikus útjára gondol, a tényleges utazási idő hogyan viszonyul ahhoz, amire számít?
hu.#How would you describe your level of ti: Hogyan jellemezné a fáradtságát a tipikus utazás befejezése után?
hu.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Ha a tipikus utazása kifárasztja, mi ennek Ön szerint a fő oka?
hu.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Fizikai erőfeszítés (pl. gyaloglás, kerékpározás, táskák cipelése)
hu.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Mentális stressz (pl. forgalom, tájékozódás, időnyomás, bizonytalanságérzet)
hu.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Környezeti kellemetlenség (pl. hőség, zaj, rossz levegőminőség)
hu.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Várakozás és állás (pl. megállókban vagy sorban)
hu.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: Általában nem vagyok fáradt az utazásaim után
hu.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: Milyen gyakran érzi magát szorongónak vagy túlterheltnek a tipikus utazása során?
hu.#What specifically makes you feel anxiou: Mi okozza leginkább, hogy szorongónak vagy túlterheltnek érzi magát a tipikus utazása során?
hu.#Aggressive or unsafe behavior from othe: Más közlekedők agresszív vagy veszélyes viselkedése (járművezetők, kerékpárosok, gyalogosok)
hu.#Noise, crowding, or other sensory overl: Zaj, tömeg vagy túl sok környezeti inger
hu.#Feeling isolated or alone while traveli: Az elszigeteltség vagy egyedüllét érzése utazás közben
hu.#Safety and security concerns (e.g., acc: Közlekedésbiztonsági vagy személyes biztonsági aggodalmak (pl. baleset, bűncselekmény)
hu.#I don't usually feel anxious or overwhe: Általában nem érzem magam szorongónak vagy túlterheltnek
hu.#Compared to other travel options availa: Az Ön számára elérhető más lehetőségekhez, például gyalogláshoz, autózáshoz vagy tömegközlekedéshez képest hogyan értékeli a szokásos közlekedési módjához szükséges teljes erőfeszítést?
hu.#My current mode is significantly easier: A jelenlegi közlekedési módom lényegesen könnyebb és nyugodtabb minden más lehetőségnél
hu.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Ez egy kicsit könnyebb, mint más módok, amelyeket használhatnék
hu.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: A közlekedési módtól függetlenül nagyjából ugyanakkora erőfeszítésnek érzem
hu.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Ez valamivel több energiát vesz ki belőlem, mint a többi lehetőség
hu.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Sokkal megterhelőbb a többi lehetőségnél, fizikailag vagy lelkileg
hu.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: Hogyan befolyásolja az útvonal „élettelisége”, vagyis más emberek, üzletek és tevékenységek jelenléte az utazását?
hu.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Nagyon pozitívan: az élénk környezet biztonságosabbá vagy kényelmesebbé teszi számomra az utat
hu.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Inkább pozitívan: az élénk környezet javítja az utazási élményemet
hu.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: Semlegesen: a környezet aktivitása nem befolyásolja az utazásomat
hu.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Inkább negatívan: a csendes vagy üres területek kényelmetlen érzést kelthetnek
hu.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Nagyon negatívan: a túl forgalmas vagy zsúfolt területek stresszessé vagy nehezen áttekinthetővé teszik az utat

ar.#Welcome to Your Experience on the Move: مرحبًا بك في استبيان تجربة التنقل
ar.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
يتناول هذا الاستبيان من SmartUrbanity شعورك وتجربتك أثناء التنقل، بما في ذلك المشي وركوب الدراجة والنقل العام والسيارة والدراجة النارية وجودة الطريق. تساعدنا إجاباتك على تحديد العوائق وفرص تحسين التنقل الحضري. المشاركة طوعية ومجهولة الهوية.

اعرف المزيد عن SmartUrbanity
ar.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: تم تسجيل إجابتك. شكرًا لوقتك في إكمال هذا الاستبيان.
ar.#<p>The following questions refer to you: تشير الأسئلة التالية إلى رحلتك المعتادة، أي الرحلة التي تقوم بها غالبًا في حياتك اليومية، مثل الذهاب إلى العمل أو الجامعة أو المدرسة أو التسوق أو أي نشاط منتظم آخر.
ar.#How would you describe your emotional s: كيف تصف حالتك النفسية أثناء رحلة معتادة؟
ar.#Thinking about your typical journey, ho: عند التفكير في رحلتك المعتادة، كيف يقارن الوقت الفعلي للرحلة بالوقت الذي تتوقعه؟
ar.#How would you describe your level of ti: كيف تصف مستوى التعب بعد إكمال رحلتك المعتادة؟
ar.#If your typical journey makes you feel: إذا كانت رحلتك المعتادة تسبب لك التعب، فما السبب الرئيسي برأيك؟
ar.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: مجهود بدني (مثل المشي، ركوب الدراجة، حمل الحقائب)
ar.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: ضغط نفسي (مثل حركة المرور، معرفة الطريق، ضيق الوقت، الشعور بعدم الأمان)
ar.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: انزعاج بسبب البيئة (مثل الحر، الضوضاء، سوء جودة الهواء)
ar.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: الانتظار والوقوف (مثل الانتظار في المحطات أو الطوابير)
ar.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: عادةً لا أشعر بالتعب بعد رحلاتي
ar.#How often do you feel anxious or overwh: كم مرة تشعر بالقلق أو الضغط الزائد أثناء رحلتك المعتادة؟
ar.#What specifically makes you feel anxiou: ما الذي يجعلك تشعر بالقلق أو الضغط الزائد أثناء رحلتك المعتادة؟
ar.#Aggressive or unsafe behavior from othe: سلوك عدواني أو خطر من مستخدمي الطريق الآخرين (السائقون، راكبو الدراجات، المشاة)
ar.#Noise, crowding, or other sensory overl: الضوضاء أو الازدحام أو كثرة المؤثرات من حولي
ar.#Feeling isolated or alone while traveli: الشعور بالعزلة أو الوحدة أثناء التنقل
ar.#Safety and security concerns (e.g., acc: مخاوف تتعلق بالسلامة المرورية أو الأمان الشخصي (مثل الحوادث أو الجريمة)
ar.#Physical health concerns (pain, breathl: مشكلات صحية جسدية (ألم، ضيق تنفس، دوار)
ar.#I don't usually feel anxious or overwhe: عادةً لا أشعر بالقلق أو الضغط الزائد
ar.#Compared to other travel options availa: مقارنةً بوسائل التنقل الأخرى المتاحة لك، مثل المشي أو القيادة أو النقل العام، كيف تقيّم إجمالي الجهد المطلوب لاستخدام وسيلة التنقل المعتادة لديك؟
ar.#My current mode is significantly easier: وسيلتي الحالية أسهل وأكثر راحة بوضوح من أي بديل
ar.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: هي أسهل قليلًا من الطرق الأخرى التي يمكنني استخدامها
ar.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: بغض النظر عن الوسيلة، أشعر أن الجهد متقارب تقريبًا
ar.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: هذه الوسيلة تتطلب مني طاقة أكبر قليلًا من الخيارات الأخرى
ar.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: أكثر إرهاقًا بكثير من البدائل، جسديًا أو نفسيًا
ar.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: كيف يؤثر مستوى النشاط والحيوية على طريقك، أي وجود أشخاص ومتاجر وأنشطة، في رحلتك؟
ar.#Very positively, lively environments ma: بشكل إيجابي جدًا: الأماكن الحيوية تجعلني أشعر بأمان أو راحة أكبر
ar.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: بشكل إيجابي إلى حد ما: الأماكن الحيوية تحسن تجربة التنقل
ar.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: بشكل محايد: مستوى النشاط لا يؤثر في رحلتي
ar.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: بشكل سلبي إلى حد ما: الأماكن الهادئة أو الخالية قد تجعلني غير مرتاح
ar.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: بشكل سلبي جدًا: الأماكن شديدة الازدحام تجعل الرحلة مرهقة أو تجعل معرفة الطريق أصعب
